We are looking for a proactive, organized, and detail-oriented Associate - Office Administration & Facilities/IT Coordination to manage the organization's IT infrastructure needs while supporting day-to-day administrative and operational activities. This role is ideal for someone who can take ownership of device and workplace management, coordinate effectively with internal teams and external vendors, and ensure that IT and operational requirements are handled efficiently, securely, and on time. You will work closely with multiple teams and stakeholders to maintain a secure, well-organized, and efficient work environment.

What you will do

  • Manage end-to-end procurement of IT devices and equipment (laptops and accessories) - sourcing, obtaining quotations, and coordinating purchases in line with business needs
  • Set up and configure new devices, install required software, and ensure a smooth onboarding experience for employees
  • Maintain and monitor IT security practices in line with ISO 27001 standards, including device compliance, access controls, and adherence to information security policies
  • Maintain accurate records of IT assets - allocation, tracking, servicing, and disposal - and keep documentation audit-ready
  • Troubleshoot device, software, and network/connectivity issues, including ensuring smooth office internet connectivity, escalating to relevant vendors or teams for prompt resolution when required
  • Assist and support with the day-to-day upkeep of office facilities, coordinating with internal teams, vendors, and service providers as needed

What we expect

  • Diploma, HND, in Information Technology, Business Administration, Operations, or a related field
  • 1 year of experience in IT support, office administration/operations, or a similar role
  • Hands-on knowledge of device setup, software installation, and basic IT troubleshooting
  • Good communication, coordination, and interpersonal skills
  • Strong organizational, follow-up, and time management abilities
  • Ability to take ownership of tasks, work independently, and ensure timely completion
  • Ability to coordinate effectively with vendors, service providers, and internal stakeholders
  • Good attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate records and documentation
  • Good working knowledge of Google Suite applications - Sheets, Docs, Slides, etc.

*Willingness to work on Saturdays (half-day); compensated with a half-day off on a weekday

Importantly, we are looking for someone who will live by our core values that define everything we do: Excellence, Collaboration, and Integrity.

What is it like to work at Rootcode

Work is a large part of our lives, so we aim to create an environment that feels supportive and open. We trust people to make good decisions and give them the space to do their best work. At Rootcode you will have:

  • Fast-paced career growth
  • Opportunity to work with the latest technologies
  • Freedom with responsibility

Who we are

Rootcode is a software product engineering company headquartered in Sri Lanka with a corporate office in Estonia. We serve customers across Europe and North America. We work with many EU governments and enterprises, building software products, artificial intelligence, and user experience design for clients ranging from startups to public companies.

If the above sounds like a match, we would like to hear from you.

We are looking for engineers who are curious, reliable, and comfortable taking on new challenges. You will work with a skilled team on meaningful and complex software projects.

What you will do

  • Design, build, and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable code

  • Build scalable applications and take part in architectural design

  • Identify and apply suitable design patterns and frameworks

  • Use testing and code quality tools to maintain strong engineering standards

  • Review code and guide junior developers, helping them grow and succeed

  • Follow Rootcode information security policies, including data protection, access controls, encryption, and secure coding practices

What we expect

  • A bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience building applications using React on the front end and Python, Java, or Typescript on the back end

  • Strong understanding of front-end and back-end architecture.

  • Familiarity with RESTful API development and integration.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively within a collaborative team environment.

  • Familiarity with cloud platforms and basic knowledge of deployment and infrastructure concepts

We look for people who reflect our values: excellence, collaboration, and integrity.

We are on the lookout for a driven, resourceful, and commercially sharp individual who lives for the hunt. You are someone who builds pipelines from scratch, knows how to find the right prospects online, and takes genuine pride in turning a cold contact into a qualified opportunity. Together with the team, you will support the commercial growth of Skapp — our all-in-one, integrated business operations platform designed to centralize people, projects, and organizational processes — across Sri Lanka and Asia.

What you will do

  • Identify and prospect B2B targets across Sri Lanka and Asia through online research and cold outreach — calls, emails, and social selling.
  • Build a qualified sales pipeline from the ground up, with clear tracking and structured follow-through.
  • Conduct sharp, consultative product demonstrations tailored to HR, operations, and leadership stakeholders.
  • Support the full sales lifecycle — prospecting, outreach, pitching, quoting, and closing.
  • Prepare proposals, commercial quotes, and follow-up plans that move deals forward.
  • Coordinate closely with the field sales team to hand off and support larger opportunities.
  • Collaborate with the marketing team to support lead generation strategies and campaigns.
  • Conduct market research to continuously refine your prospecting approach and positioning.
  • Maintain accurate records in the CRM and share customer and market insights with the product team to help shape the Skapp roadmap.

What we expect

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in B2B SaaS or software product sales, ideally within Sri Lanka or Asia.
  • A proven track record in outbound sales — cold calling, cold emailing, and online prospecting should be tools you reach for naturally, not reluctantly.
  • Strong presentation, communication, and negotiation skills across diverse stakeholder groups.
  • The ability to deeply understand a software product and articulate its value clearly and compellingly.
  • Experience selling HRIS, project management, workflow, or SaaS solutions is a significant advantage.
  • Consultative selling experience with HR, operations, or leadership buyers is a plus.
  • Target-driven, self-motivated, and capable of working independently in a fast-paced environment.

At Rootcode, our AI division works with governments and enterprises to develop solutions for complex, high-stakes problems. This includes implementing key parts of national AI strategies for our government customers and building intelligent systems for global enterprises.

As a Solutions Architect - AI, you will work directly inside customer environments to understand their business, discover high-impact AI and data use-cases, and deliver the right technical solution end to end. You will run discovery workshops, define architecture, and own delivery through to production. You will lead engagements across enterprise, startup, and government customers, making architecture decisions across modern and emerging AI domains, often in environments where there is no existing playbook.

What you will do


  • Work directly inside customer environments across enterprises, startups, and governments to develop a deep understanding of their business, operations, and strategic priorities.

  • Lead the technical response to enterprise and government tenders and RFPs, defining solution architecture and crafting high-quality bid submissions

  • Make architecture decisions across modern and emerging AI domains, selecting tools, technologies and design patterns that fit the problem, the customer's constraints, and the realities of production.

  • Run discovery workshops to uncover high-impact AI and data use-cases and translate them into well-scoped, actionable solutions.

  • Lead proofs of concept end to end, from hypothesis to outcome, using them to de-risk architecture decisions and build technical credibility with the customer.

  • Own delivery execution on your engagements, taking full accountability for quality, technical direction, and outcomes through to production.

  • Maintain alignment with senior customer stakeholders throughout the engagement, surfacing risks, managing expectations, and holding the technical narrative clearly at every stage.

  • Define engineering standards and review architecture and design decisions made by the teams working under your engagements.

  • Stay close to emerging AI research and tooling and make clear-eyed judgments on what is production-ready and relevant for the problems you are solving.

  • Adhere to Rootcode’s established information security policies and procedures, including but not limited to data protection, access controls, encryption standards, and secure coding practices.



What we expect

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related field

  • 8+ years of experience building and shipping production-grade software, with at least 3+ years leading architecture and engineering of AI or ML systems, with hands-on exposure to modern AI domains including LLMs, RAG, or agentic systems.

  • Proven ability to work independently within customer environments, lead technical discovery, and manage engagement execution across one or more of startups, enterprises, and government customers.

  • Deep experience designing and owning solution architecture across varying scales and levels of complexity, with a strong grasp of modern AI and data architecture design patterns

  • Experience working across data and integration layers through to application and AI services

  • Experience designing systems that meet enterprise-grade requirements around security, scalability, reliability, observability, and compliance

  • Experience making and defending architecture decisions on complex, real-world systems under ambiguity

  • Experience mentoring and guiding engineers on architecture decisions and engineering best practices

  • Experience leading technical conversations with senior stakeholders including C-suite decision-makers, and translating complex technical decisions into clear business terms

  • Experience leading technical responses to enterprise and government tenders and RFPs is an advantage
